name: Kinable
headline: Knowing what to build,
before building it.
summary: A mobile app for families caring for someone living with dementia. A specification, a working prototype and a realistic roadmap gave the team the certainty to begin development.
scope: Business and technical specification, prototyping & delivery planning

image.alt: Kinable working mobile build: care onboarding with an older man at a doorway.

challenge.title: Certainty before committing to a full build.
paragraphs: Before committing to a full build, the Kinable team needed to know exactly what the first version should do, what it would cost, and how long it would take — with enough certainty to start.

timeline.title: Business and technical specification
timeline.description: One shared document defining what the app does, who it is for and how it would be built.

timeline.title: An AI-built prototype
timeline.description: A working, clickable mobile prototype to judge the product by using it.

timeline.title: Estimate and roadmap
timeline.description: A realistic cost and phased plan, set out before committing to the build.

timeline.title: Now in development
timeline.description: The build is under way, with the specification, prototype and roadmap holding through development.

approach.title: One specification, shared by business and technology.
paragraphs: We created one document covering what the app does, who it is for and how it would be built — the business logic and the technical decisions together, not in separate silos.

showcases.label: Daily care and care plans in matching Kinable phone frames

Kinable care plans: all eight care categories, with Passport selected in the navigation.

approach.title: A product to try, not just a document to read.
paragraphs: We used AI tooling to produce a working, clickable mobile prototype quickly, so the product could be judged by using it rather than by reading about it.
The screens below are from the working build: everyday care, family coordination and care plans in one place.

approach.title: A realistic estimate and a phased roadmap.
paragraphs: We set out a realistic cost and a phased plan, so the team knew what they were committing to before they committed to it.

outcome.summary: The build is now under way, with the groundwork holding.
paragraphs: The specification, prototype and roadmap are holding through development — the real test of whether the groundwork was right.
